info.name: Experiment Copilot API
info.description:
Live API reference for the frontend team. Every request/response body below was captured from a real run against the actual server (`uvicorn app.main:app`) — including two real Gemini-generated hypotheses, a real simulated metrics series, and a real executive report — not hand-typed.

Two parallel paths exist:

1. **AI-driven (LangGraph) path** — `POST /context` -> `POST /context/{context_id}/hypothesis` (runs context_agent + hypothesis_agent, pauses) -> `POST /experiments/{id}/validate` **with** a metric-selection body (resumes experiment_design_agent + validation_agent, pauses again) -> `POST /experiments/{id}/launch` (resumes simulation -> statistics -> explanation -> report_agent, all the way to a persisted report).
2. **Manual path** — `POST /experiments` with a caller-supplied hypothesis + configuration (no AI, no graph) -> `POST /experiments/{id}/validate` **without** a body (rule engine only) -> `POST /experiments/{id}/launch` (registers the live 5-second-tick scheduler, no AI narration).

`POST /experiments/{id}/validate` and `POST /experiments/{id}/launch` both auto-detect which path an experiment is on (a paused LangGraph thread vs. not) and behave accordingly — same URL either way.

request.description: Every pre-set enum the platform knows about (features, audiences, metrics, traffic splits, durations, confidence levels, sample sizes, statuses). request.description: Empty body — the context id is in the path. request.description: For an experiment created via POST /context/{id}/hypothesis (a paused LangGraph thread exists): the body must be `{primary_metric, secondary_metrics}`, each the FULL catalog list for that role with exactly the ids the PM wants selected. Every id in `primary_metric` must cover exactly the catalog's primary-eligible ids (same for `secondary_metrics`), and exactly one `primary_metric` entry must be `selected: true`. Applying this replaces the hypothesis's metric selection, then resumes the graph: experiment_design_agent (real Gemini call) -> validation_agent, pausing again before simulation.

request.description:
Empty body. Auto-detects the path:
- Paused graph thread (AI-driven): resumes simulation_node (real ticks until sample_size is reached, writing Metrics rows) -> statistics_node -> explanation_agent (real Gemini call) -> report_agent (real Gemini call, persists the report) -> END. Can take a while for a large sample_size — this is synchronous.
- No graph thread (manual): registers the live 5-second-tick scheduler (`GET /metrics` fills in over time instead of all at once).

request.description: Manually halts a running (manual-path, live-ticking) experiment and deregisters its scheduler job.

request.description: Regenerates the executive report from the CURRENT statistics/recommendation and overwrites whatever report already exists (even one report_agent wrote during an AI-driven /launch) — always the latest snapshot, deterministic summary unless an optional body with `summary`/`business_impact`/`next_steps`/`recommendation` overrides is passed.
